RealFoley - licences and provenance
Prepared October 17, 2026 for the Jewelry-store-vr-demo project. Status: fetched and processed; not wired; not auditioned (unverified).

Every audio file in this folder is a processed copy of a real recording (or a mix of two, marked 'layered' in sources.json).
No file is synthesized, NonCommercial, NoDerivatives, ShareAlike or of unknown licence.

CC0 1.0 Universal: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/  (no attribution required; credits below are voluntary)
CC BY 3.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/   CC BY 4.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ATTRIBUTION REQUIRED (show in the in-app credits and keep in Docs/ASSET_REGISTER.md):
  CameraShutter_02.wav: "camera snap" by thecheeseman (https://freesound.org/people/thecheeseman/sounds/51360/), edited by ketufaispikinut (Space Station 14), licensed CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/); trimmed and normalised.
  ServerFans_Loop.ogg: "Server fans" by DeVern (https://freesound.org/people/DeVern/sounds/610761/), licensed CC BY 3.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/); via Space Station 14; trimmed, looped and normalised.

Licence verification: freesound.org and opengameart.org could not be opened from the preparation environment. The licence of
each recording is taken from the licence record of the GitHub mirror that supplied it (copies or excerpts in Licenses/).
Please open the original pages once before a public release. Changes to every file: trimming, mono/stereo downmix,
resampling to 48 kHz, high-pass filtering, fades, loudness normalisation, loop crossfades, layering (see sources.json).
